ng-lib-build.description: Buildable Angular-Lib ohne ng-package.json/package.json/tsconfig.lib*.json pro Lib (delegiert an @nx/angular:ng-packagr-lite).

ng-lib-application.description: @nx/angular:application gegen dist der Libs, Alias-Mapping aus tsconfig.base.json statt lib-package.json.

ng-lib-test.description: @nx/angular:unit-test für Libs ohne ng-package.json/tsconfig.spec.json pro Lib (tsConfig = gemeinsame spec-tsconfig, include wird auf die Lib verengt).

openapi-generate.description: OpenAPI client via the configured adapter (openapi-clients.json), split into the libs types/api/core (src/generated/**, gitignored).

openapi-update-spec.description: Downloads the spec from its url (openapi-clients.json) and writes it normalized into the committed spec file.

openapi-generate-testing.description: Testing lib of a client from its spec: openapi-typescript (paths), orval msw mocks (faker), openapi-msw (<client>Http), default handlers (src/generated/**, gitignored).
